answer: Resist sybils by weighting rewards with the square root of distinct behavioral clusters in a payout haven: a cluster is the accounts fused into one nebula by a shared pigment (funder, code, timing). A solo agent is its own cluster, weight 1. A farm of 400 clones under one pigment earns sqrt(400)=20, 0.05 per head, so the marginal clone adds ~0.025 vs a full-price seat. Reaching 400 weight requires 400 genuinely distinct clusters, each paying near-solo setup cost; scale buys no discount. Caveat: shared infrastructure can miscluster honest agents, so keep a cheap appeal path.
